content.value_statement: Marketing teams often struggle to compare campaign performance across platforms. This skill calculates engagement, ROI, benchmarks, and recommendations from provided campaign data.
actual_capabilities: Calculates engagement rate, CTR, reach, impressions, clicks, and total engagements.
Computes cost per engagement, cost per click, estimated value, and ROI percentage.
Ranks top posts using engagement rate or another selected metric.
Compares Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok metrics against built-in benchmarks.
Generates threshold-based strengths, weaknesses, and optimization recommendations.
limitations: Requires exported or manually provided data; it does not connect to platform APIs.
ROI uses a fixed average value per engagement unless the user changes the method.
Benchmarks are hardcoded examples and may not fit every industry.
Recommendations depend on data quality and campaign context.

use_cases.title: Build Client Campaign Reports
use_cases.description: Summarize engagement, click performance, ROI, and recommendations for a client campaign review.

use_cases.title: Choose Better Content Formats
use_cases.description: Compare image, video, and carousel posts to see which formats produce stronger engagement.

use_cases.title: Review Paid Social Efficiency
use_cases.description: Measure cost per click, cost per engagement, and estimated ROI before adjusting paid budgets.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Basic Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Use social-media-analyzer to calculate engagement rate and CTR for this campaign data. Summarize the strongest and weakest posts.

prompt_templates.title: Calculate Paid Campaign ROI
prompt_templates.prompt: Use social-media-analyzer to calculate cost per engagement, cost per click, estimated value, and ROI for this paid campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Platform Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Use social-media-analyzer to compare these Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Twitter, and TikTok results against built-in benchmarks.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Optimization Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Use social-media-analyzer to audit this campaign, rank top posts, explain benchmark gaps, and recommend budget and content changes.

output_examples.input: Three Instagram posts with $500 spend, 18,200 reach, 27,700 impressions, 430 clicks, and 1,521 engagements.
output: Average engagement rate is 8.36%, which is above the Instagram benchmark.
CTR is 1.55%, and cost per click is $1.16.
Estimated ROI is 660.5% using the default engagement value.
The carousel post has the strongest engagement rate.
Recommendation: test more carousel and video content before increasing spend.

output_examples.input: A Facebook ad campaign with high spend, low CTR, and limited post volume.
output: CTR is below the platform benchmark and needs creative testing.
Cost efficiency is weak because paid clicks are expensive.
Low post volume makes the recommendation less reliable.
Recommendation: refine targeting, test clearer calls to action, and gather more post data.

best_practices: Provide complete reach, impressions, clicks, spend, and engagement data for each post.
Compare campaigns from the same time period and similar audience context.
Separate organic and paid results before interpreting ROI or engagement trends.
anti_patterns: Using partial metrics and treating the result as a complete performance audit.
Comparing platforms without considering their different engagement and CTR benchmarks.
Treating the default estimated ROI as verified revenue.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide platform, post metrics, reach, impressions, clicks, spend, and the campaign time period.

faq.question: Which platforms are covered?
faq.answer: The built-in benchmarks cover Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok.

faq.question: Does the skill connect to social media APIs?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes data that you export or provide manually.

faq.question: How is engagement rate calculated?
faq.answer: It divides total engagements by reach, then multiplies the result by 100.

faq.question: Can it estimate campaign ROI?
faq.answer: Yes. It estimates ROI from spend and a default value per engagement.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
